scientific_integrity: Finite computations are consistency checks; the all-dimensional proof is mathematical. Bibliographic comparisons and limits are recorded without claiming independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact census uses classical Dedekind numbers, not an elementary formula. Asymptotics use the established Kleitman–Markowsky/Korshunov estimates; exhaustive computational verification covers dimensions 0–4 only. A specialized unindexed equivalent cannot be excluded.
title: A fourfold Dedekind law for one-point types over Boolean cubes
